acceptance_checks.current_desktop_platform: Electron 42 desktop shell (packages/desktop) whose renderer editor engine is @muyajs/core (packages/muya, TypeScript rewrite); the legacy packages/muyajs JavaScript engine (@marktext/muyajs, the muya/ alias) is retained only as a retiring dependency/alias with a few remaining call sites.
runtime_boundaries_identified: Main/preload/renderer security boundary: contextIsolation: true, sandbox: true, nodeIntegration: false; renderer reaches main only through the typed contextBridge surface in preload/index.ts (config.ts, preload/index.ts, context-isolation.spec.ts).
Window/session/tab/path identity: ephemeral BrowserWindow.id vs durable buffer-store id (editor.ts) vs logical tab id vs normalized+resolved path key for comparison and watching.

File workflow semantics: loadMarkdownFile snapshot (markdown/encoding/BOM/EOL/trailing-newline) and atomic fsync+rename save with parent-dir recreation, plus watcher that separates dir-vs-file changes from own-save echoes (filesystem/markdown.ts, filesystem/index.ts, watcher.ts).

Editor host boundary inside the renderer: markdown + serialized cursor/capabilities in; content/selection/history signals out; engine block tree, OT ops, internal history and DOM references kept out of the file protocol (editor.vue adapter logic).
